item.description: Tyler Reddick had trouble corralling his young son on a Disney cruise and then inside a cramped motorhome in the days leading into the Daytona 500.

item.title: Anthony Edwards claims MVP award, leads Stars to tourney win in an entertaining NBA All-Star Game
item.description: The NBA’s fourth All-Star format in four years matched two teams of Americans against a team representing everywhere else.

item.title: U.S. men’s hockey rolls past Germany, closes Winter Olympics group play unbeaten
item.description: With NHL stars back in the Winter Olympics for the first time in 12 years, organizers of the Milan-Cortina hockey tournament have seemingly done everything they can to make the players feel at home.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the US with more surgeries to come, team official tells AP
item.description: Lindsey Vonn was preparing to fly back to her home country on Sunday after her terrifying head-over-heels crash in the Olympic downhill, the U.S. Ski Team’s chief told The Associated Press.

item.title: Collin Morikawa birdies the 18th to win Pebble Beach and end more than 2-year drought
item.description: Collin Morikawa had gone 28 months since his last win, and he was reminded Sunday at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-am why it’s never easy.

item.title: Anthony Kim wins LIV Golf Adelaide in a remarkable career comeback
item.description: Anthony Kim walked out of a PGA Tour scoring trailer at Quail Hollow and straight to the parking lot on May 4, 2012. He put his clubs in the trunk and drove away, vanishing from golf and from the public view for 12 years.

item.title: Mikaela Shiffrin finishes outside top 10 in giant slalom as her Olympic woes continue
item.description: What’s behind her has been well documented — the Olympic disappointments, the crash that nearly ended her career — but it was what unfurled in front of her Sunday that transfixed Mikaela Shiffrin.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard and LeBron James shine at All-Star Game in LA, but young legs prevail
item.description: When Kawhi Leonard was growing up in Moreno Valley, Calif., he used to come to the NBA’s All-Star Weekend in Los Angeles at the arena then known as Staples Center and mingle around the Los Angeles Convention Center during the festivities.
